user.title: Connect Calendora
user.description:
In Calendora, create an API key and paste it below.

The key needs read access to your household and calendar. Treat it like a password.

data_description.api_key: The key Calendora gave you. It starts with cal_.

reauth_confirm.title: Calendora needs a new API key
reauth_confirm.description:
Calendora is no longer accepting the key this integration has. That usually means it was revoked or has expired.

Create a new key in Calendora and paste it below — everything you have already set up will keep working.

data_description.api_key: A new key with the same permissions as the old one.

reconfigure.title: Replace your Calendora API key
reconfigure.description: Paste a new key below. Your entities and automations stay exactly as they are — no need to remove this integration and add it again.

data_description.api_key: The key Calendora gave you. It starts with cal_.

error.invalid_auth: Calendora did not accept that key. Check you copied all of it, and that it has not been revoked.
error.missing_scope: That key does not have enough permissions. Create one that can read your household and calendar, then try again.
error.cannot_connect: Home Assistant could not reach Calendora. Check this machine's internet connection and try again.
error.unknown: Something unexpected went wrong. Check the Home Assistant log for details.

abort.already_configured: That API key is already set up.
abort.reconfigure_successful: Calendora is now using the new key.

invalid_auth.message: Calendora rejected the API key. It may have been revoked or expired — open the Calendora integration and add a new key.

missing_scope.message: The Calendora API key is missing a permission: {detail}

cannot_connect.message: Could not reach Calendora. Home Assistant will keep trying.

server_error.message: Calendora answered with an error. Home Assistant will keep trying.

unexpected_response.message: Calendora returned data in an unexpected shape. This is a bug — please report it at the issue tracker.
